state.target_treatment: Original CMIP6 biomass-burning forcing versus the revised SMBB implementation in CESM2-LENS2.
state.scope: All 100 documented LENS2 members, with the forcing change during 1990-2020. Member groups and initialization dates follow the official page; no independent climate-state count is inferred from output fields.

evidence.location: Initialization groups; Modifications incorporated in the second half
evidence.text: LENS2 has two 50-member halves: original biomass-burning forcing and an 11-year-running-mean version, SMBB, affecting 1990-2020. At each of four macro-initialization dates (1231, 1251, 1281, 1301), the first ten micro-perturbation members use original forcing and the second ten use SMBB. Ten additional even-decade initializations use original forcing; ten odd-decade initializations use SMBB.

The SMBB implementation also corrects emission-dataset issues and changes the timing of a crop-harvest carbon-flux term. The project reports no significant solution changes from the former corrections and no climate-changing impacts from the latter. Additional output fields also differ.

q1.instructions: How should the documented members be classified with respect to the original versus SMBB biomass-burning forcing protocol? Select exactly one option. Use other only when the evidence establishes an answer outside the substantive alternatives. Use not_stated when missing, incomplete, or ambiguous supplied evidence prevents this judgment without unresolved incompatible statements. Use conflicting only for unresolved incompatible evidence about this same judgment and scope.

criteria.all_original: Every member uses the original biomass-burning forcing protocol.
criteria.all_smbb: Every member uses the SMBB biomass-burning forcing protocol.
criteria.two_protocol_groups: The collection contains members using each of the two documented forcing protocols.
criteria.within_run_replicates: Each member contains separate original and SMBB runs as internal replicate executions.
criteria.other: The evidence establishes a different substantive answer from those listed.
criteria.not_stated: The supplied evidence does not establish the requested judgment.
criteria.conflicting: The supplied evidence contains unresolved incompatible accounts of this judgment and scope.

q2.instructions: Does the documented difference between these halves isolate biomass-burning smoothing as the only implementation change? Select exactly one option. Use not_stated when missing, incomplete, or ambiguous supplied evidence prevents this judgment without unresolved incompatible statements. Use conflicting only for unresolved incompatible evidence about this same judgment and scope.

criteria.smoothing_only: Yes; the two halves differ only in the biomass-burning smoothing operation.
criteria.bundled_changes: No; the SMBB half also incorporates other documented implementation changes.
criteria.initialization_only: No forcing or code difference is present; only the initial conditions differ.
criteria.not_stated: The supplied evidence does not establish the requested judgment.
criteria.conflicting: The supplied evidence contains unresolved incompatible accounts of this judgment and scope.
